fields.hd: ((m_neg_positive - m_antonym) / 2 if m_neg_positive is not None and m_antonym is not None else None)
fields.negpos_half: m_neg_positive / 2 if m_neg_positive is not None else None
fields.ant_half: m_antonym / 2 if m_antonym is not None else None
